files.title: Research download: dotted H19-5, wider spacing (D2.8)
files.summary: Owner-mirrored H19-5 raster thinned by deterministic Poisson-disk dotting to 44,090 pixels (73% of the 0.2477-labelled mirror; 36% of H19-5). Conditional on unverified owner-reported score anchors, the H28 model estimates DTI 0.2510 and this file is its best point in the tested dot_thin(H19-5, d) sweep (d=1.8–4.0 px); this is a model output, not a competition score. The model-implied 12,691 truth count and 1.85-px concentration are fitted latent parameters, not verified hidden labels. This file is byte-identical to an owner-mirrored unscored alternate. It has not demonstrated a win over a comparable same-run holdout best and remains unscored/not slot-approved; the historical 0.152003389 comparator does not reproduce (IR-25-COMPARATOR-DRIFT).
files.expected_range: 0.247–0.255 (conditional H28 model; owner claims unverified; not a score)

files.gate_summary: The shared-mask paired diagnostic compares D2.8 with the 0.2477-labelled owner mirror, not with hidden catalogue holdout truth or a current same-run spatial best. Its +0.0042 (4/4 folds) is diagnostic only, not a promotion gate. H28's separate 30-arm hide-and-recover experiment tested modelled emission choices; its registered gate failed and promoted no artifact. That experiment does not establish that this downloadable owner-mirror raster beats a current comparable same-run holdout best. The frozen 0.152003389 absolute comparator failed reproduction and cannot be used cross-run.
